translation.name: Biblica® Wonhia ɛho kwamma nhoma Akuapem Twi Nkwa Asɛm

content: Dawid dwom a ɔtoo bere a ɔboapa dan ɔbɔdamfo wɔ Abimelek anim no na ɔpanyin no gyaa no ma ɔkɔe no akyi.

content.text: Mede aseda bɛma Awurade bere nyinaa;
nʼayeyi wɔ mʼanom daa.
Me kra bɛhoahoa ne ho wɔ Awurade mu;
ma amanehunufo nte na wonni ahurusi.
Mo ne me nkamfo Awurade;
momma yɛmmɔ mu nkamfo ne din!
Mefrɛɛ Awurade na ogyee me so;
na ogyee me wɔ nea misuro nyinaa mu.
Wɔn a wɔhwɛ nʼanim no hyerɛn
na wɔn anim rengu ase da.
Ohiani yi frɛe, na Awurade tiee no;
na ogyee no fii nʼahohia nyinaa mu.
Awurade bɔfo wɛn wɔn a wosuro no,
na ogye wɔn.
Monka nhwɛ na munhu sɛ Awurade ye.
Nhyira ne onipa a oguan toa no.
Munsuro Awurade, mo a moyɛ nʼahotefo,
na wɔn a wosuro no no nhia hwee.
Gyata yɛ mmerɛw na ɔkɔm de wɔn,
nanso wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no, ade pa biara remmɔ wɔn.
Mommra, me mma, monyɛ aso mma me;
mɛkyerɛkyerɛ mo Awurade ho suro.
Mo mu hena na ɔpɛ nkwa
na ɔpɛ sɛ ohu nna pa bebree?
Ɛne ɛnsɛ sɛ ɔka kasa bɔne, na ɛsɛ sɛ ogyae atorotwa.
Twe wo ho fi bɔne ho, na yɛ papa;
hwehwɛ asomdwoe na tiw no.
Awurade ani wɔ atreneefo so
na otie wɔn mpaebɔ;
Awurade ani sa wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne,
sɛ obeyi wɔn nkae afi asase yi so.
Atreneefo teɛ mu su, na Awurade tie wɔn;
oyi wɔn fi wɔn haw nyinaa mu.
Awurade bɛn wɔn a wɔn koma abotow
na ogye wɔn a wɔadwerɛw wɔn wɔ honhom mu no nkwa.
Onipa trenee behu amane bebree
nanso Awurade gye no fi ne nyinaa mu;
ɔbɔ ne nnompe nyinaa ho ban,
sɛnea mu baako mpo mu remmu.
Bɔne bekum ɔdebɔneyɛni;
ɔtreneeni atamfo benya afɔbu.
Awurade gye nʼasomfo nkwa;
wɔn a woguan toa no no mu biara renkɔ afɔbu mu.
